bibl.title: Some Decorated Blocks from Antinoupolis.
bibl.seg: Hamada Kellawy, Some Decorated Blocks from Antinoupolis.
bibl.note: A group of eight carved stone blocks were discovered by the Italian Archaeological Mission at Antinoupolis during the excavation season in April 2019. All the blocks are made of limestone, except one made of sandstone; and all of them are "talatat" from the Amarna period. One explanation for the Amarna blocks is that they had been brought from Amarna and were reused by Ramesses II and his son Merenptah as fill in the temple and were reused again in the foundations of a Coptic church (IV-VII cent. AD), the place where they were found.
